Tijuana Flats Menu: Discover New Items and Fan Favorites

Tijuana Flats is a beloved Tex-Mex restaurant that offers an explosion of flavors with its delicious dishes. Whether you’re craving tacos, burritos, or specialty items, Tijuana Flats has something for everyone. This guide provides a comprehensive breakdown of the Tijuana Flats menu, from appetizers to take-home meal kits, with detailed pricing tables, restaurant timings, and frequently asked questions. Let’s dive into the world of Tex-Mex goodness!

Tijuana Flats: A Tex-Mex Delight

Tijuana Flats is known for offering a variety of Tex-Mex dishes that are made fresh with high-quality ingredients. Whether you’re dining in, ordering takeout, or opting for delivery, Tijuana Flats guarantees a flavorful experience. Here’s everything you need to know about the menu and how you can order online for delivery or pickup.

Tacos

Tijuana Flats offers a selection of tacos that can satisfy anyone’s craving for a Tex-Mex feast. Their tacos are made using either hard corn or soft flour tortillas, and you can fill them with your choice of protein. Popular options include chicken, beef, and pork al pastor. Each taco is served with chips, a delicious side that complements the meal.

Popular Tacos:

  • Dos Tacos: Two soft or hard-shell tacos with a choice of chicken, beef, or pork al pastor, topped with shredded lettuce, diced onions, cilantro, and cheese.
  • Carne Asada Tacos: Topped with queso, fresh jalapeños, and salsa.

Taco Menu Pricing Table

Taco Options Price
Dos Tacos (Chicken or Beef) $7.99
Carne Asada Tacos $9.49
Pork Al Pastor Tacos $8.99

Burritos

The burrito options at Tijuana Flats are equally satisfying. Wrapped in a soft flour tortilla, the burritos are stuffed with a variety of fillings, such as cilantro lime rice, refried beans, and a choice of protein. The burritos are often topped with sour cream, queso, and fresh jalapeños.

Popular Burritos:

  • Chicken Burrito: A hearty burrito filled with grilled chicken, melted cheddar jack cheese, sour cream, and cilantro lime rice.
  • Beef Burrito: Loaded with seasoned ground beef, refried beans, and topped with queso.
  • Smack My Ass Bangin’ Chicken Burrito: A burrito filled with crispy chicken tossed in the famous Smack My Ass sauce, wrapped in a grilled tortilla.

Burrito Menu Pricing Table

Burrito Options Price
Chicken Burrito $8.99
Beef Burrito $9.49
Smack My Ass Bangin’ Chicken Burrito $10.49

Take-Home Meal Kits

For those looking to enjoy Tijuana Flats at home, the take-home meal kits offer a convenient way to feed the whole family. These kits include a variety of options, such as tacos or burritos, served with all the essentials like chips, queso, salsa, and guac.

Meal Kit Options:

  • Taco Take-Home Kit: Includes everything you need to build your own tacos at home, including your choice of protein, tortillas, queso, and toppings.
  • Burrito Take-Home Kit: A customizable burrito kit with all the fresh ingredients you love, such as cilantro lime rice, beans, cheese, and guacamole.

Take-Home Meal Kits Pricing Table

Meal Kit Options Price
Taco Take-Home Kit $29.99
Burrito Take-Home Kit $34.99

Appetizers

Start your meal with some mouth-watering appetizers at Tijuana Flats. The appetizers include fan favorites like queso, tortilla chips, and flautas, all made from scratch.

Popular Appetizers:

  • Chips & Queso: Lightly fried tortilla chips served with signature gold queso.
  • Flautas: Crispy flautas filled with chicken or beef, wrapped in a lightly fried tortilla and served with sour cream and salsa.
  • Guac & Salsa: Fresh guacamole made with ripe avocados, cilantro, lime, and onions, paired with house-made salsa.

Appetizer Menu Pricing Table

Appetizer Options Price
Chips & Queso $4.49
Flautas (Chicken or Beef) $6.99
Guac & Salsa $5.49

Flavorful Specialties

In addition to tacos and burritos, Tijuana Flats offers flavorful specialties that showcase the restaurant’s creativity. These specialties combine classic Tex-Mex flavors with a unique twist.

Popular Specialties:

  • Green Chicken Chile Flautas: Crispy flautas stuffed with green chicken chile and cream cheese, served with salsa and queso.
  • Dos Enchiladas: Two corn tortillas filled with cheese, topped with queso, cilantro, and sour cream.
  • Quesadilla Supreme: A grilled tortilla filled with melted cheddar jack cheese, served with a side of salsa and guac.

Specialties Pricing Table

Specialty Dishes Price
Green Chicken Chile Flautas $9.99
Dos Enchiladas $8.99
Quesadilla Supreme $7.99

Delivery and Takeout Options

Whether you’re looking for delivery or takeout, Tijuana Flats makes it easy to enjoy your favorite Tex-Mex dishes from the comfort of your home. You can order online through the Tijuana Flats website or third-party services like DoorDash and Grubhub. Simply browse the Tijuana Flats menu, choose your items, and track your order for delivery or takeout. There’s even an option to schedule your delivery in advance, making it convenient for busy days.

  • Order Online at Tijuana Flats: Visit the website or app to place your order.
  • Delivery Services: Available through DoorDash, Grubhub, Uber Eats, and more.
  • Takeout from Tijuana Flats: You can pick up your order directly from the restaurant.

Tex-Mex Cuisine: A Flavorful Experience

Tijuana Flats is all about Tex-Mex flavors. From their signature tacos to flavorful burritos, every dish is packed with fresh ingredients and bold seasonings. Whether you’re a fan of refried beans, guacamole, or queso, you’re guaranteed a satisfying meal at Tijuana Flats. You can customize your dishes with your favorite toppings, such as jalapeños, cilantro, and salsa, creating a personalized Tex-Mex experience.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. What are the most popular items on the Tijuana Flats menu?

The most popular items include the Dos Tacos, Smack My Ass Bangin’ Chicken Burrito, and Chips & Queso.

2. Does Tijuana Flats offer take-home meal kits?

Yes, Tijuana Flats offers Taco and Burrito Take-Home Meal Kits that serve multiple people and come with all the fixings.

3. Can I order Tijuana Flats for delivery?

Absolutely! You can order online through the Tijuana Flats website or use third-party delivery services such as DoorDash or Grubhub.

4. Does Tijuana Flats offer vegetarian options?

Yes, Tijuana Flats has several vegetarian options, including bean burritos, quesadillas, and customizable tacos.

5. Are there any low-calorie options on the menu?

Yes, Tijuana Flats offers a “Lite Menu” with options like Grilled Chicken Tacos and Vegetarian Burritos that are lower in calories.

Restaurant Timings

Tijuana Flats operates with varying hours based on location. However, most locations follow these general hours:

  • Monday to Friday: 11 AM – 9 PM
  • Saturday: 11 AM – 10 PM
  • Sunday: 12 PM – 8 PM

Be sure to check your local Tijuana Flats for specific timings.

With this guide, you’re now fully equipped to enjoy the best that Tijuana Flats has to offer, whether you’re dining in, getting takeout, or ordering online for delivery. From tacos to burritos and flavorful specialties, Tijuana Flats continues to bring a mouthwatering Tex-Mex experience to the table.
